subject.title: message tool should auto-select the only enabled account

question: Should omitted message-tool account IDs infer the single enabled/configured account after channel selection, or should OpenClaw keep requiring explicit account selection when the default account is disabled?
rationale: The requested behavior changes a documented fallback/default path for outbound messaging, so maintainer intent is needed before the linked PR lands.

options.title: Accept the shared resolver policy
options.body: Review and land a shared resolver that preserves explicit/default/bound accounts first, then uses an enabled configured default or exactly one enabled configured account with clear zero-or-multiple errors.

options.title: Keep explicit account selection
options.body: Close or narrow the implementation path and document that users must set `accountId` or `defaultAccount` when the default account is disabled.

options.title: Require a narrower channel-owned fix
options.body: Ask for a WhatsApp-only or plugin-owned adjustment if maintainers do not want core to own this fallback policy across channels.

recommendation.title: Accept the shared resolver policy
recommendation.body: Review and land a shared resolver that preserves explicit/default/bound accounts first, then uses an enabled configured default or exactly one enabled configured account with clear zero-or-multiple errors.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the prior review direction and has the strongest current-history connection across the shared outbound/channel/account docs touched by the decision.
